idea-plugin.name: Agents Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Agents Sync — Global AGENTS.md Editor & Cross-Machine Synchronization

Seamlessly manage, edit, and synchronize a system-wide AGENTS.md guidelines file across all your projects, IDE instances, and machines using JetBrains Settings Sync (Backup & Sync).

Features:

  • Cross-Machine Synchronization: Syncs AGENTS.md and all settings across multiple machines automatically via JetBrains Account cloud sync.
  • Full-Blown Markdown Editor Tab: Open and edit your global AGENTS.md in a full IDE editor tab with live preview, syntax highlighting, and outline.
  • Snapshot Revision History: Automatic timestamped history snapshots on every change with one-click rollback and full history cloud synchronization.
  • AI Assistant & AIR Integration: Built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server allowing JetBrains AI Assistant, Junie, AIR, and Claude to read, update, and append guidelines.
  • Local File Mirroring: Automatically mirrors instructions to ~/.junie/AGENTS.md (or custom path) so CLI agents and external tools stay in sync.
  • Editor Context Actions: Right-click any code snippet in your editor to immediately promote it to a global agent guideline rule.
